title: Trends cross-source breadth promotes hot
summary: First of the queued #3 trend enhancements. The trend engine already counts controlled-vocabulary occurrences across lanes, but the hot tier could only be reached via 3+ named entities or github_trending/builder_observations evidence, so an emerging concept sustained across other lanes (main_items, hot_blogs, projects) never reached hot. Added a configurable hot.min_sections threshold and a cross-source-breadth path to topicStatus so a topic with enough occurrences and active days spanning that many distinct lanes is promoted to hot without requiring the specific evidence sections. Vocabulary and thresholds stay in config/trends.json; the change is additive (it only adds an OR path to the existing hot rule).

lessons.lesson: The hot trend tier was unreachable for cross-lane concepts; breadth is a legitimate hot signal.
lessons.evidence: A topic appearing five times over five days across main_items/hot_blogs/projects (no github/builder evidence, fewer than three entities) stayed active before and reaches hot after adding the breadth path.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep trend thresholds in config/trends.json and prefer additive OR paths over lowering existing thresholds when adding a new signal.

lessons.lesson: A sub-pixel boundingBox assertion in the Stage D mobile-scroll e2e was too strict.
lessons.evidence: After scrollIntoView the first track heading reported y of about -0.17 (sub-pixel), failing a y >= 0 assertion; relaxed to y >= -2.
lessons.recommended_action: Tolerate sub-pixel offsets in post-scroll boundingBox assertions.

lessons.lesson: The live daily publisher is the ai-2 automation, not ai-daily.
lessons.evidence: workflow:validate flagged two active daily-publish automations after ai-daily was unpaused; ai-2 (clean prompt) is already ACTIVE and is the real publisher, while ai-daily is a paused mojibake duplicate.
lessons.recommended_action: Treat ai-2 as the authoritative daily publish automation; keep ai-daily/ai-daily-2 paused to satisfy the exactly-one-active contract.

followups.action: Remaining queued #3 work: GitHub Trending API field enrichment (topics/star-velocity/license) and a curated first-party X handle ingestion path.
